title: The initial-connect fallback retry test can pass with the retry removed
outcome: 'retries initial-connect fallback resyncs after a transient /api/state failure' fails when the retry it tests is removed.
acceptance: The test fails with a recorded run when the retry at about app-live-state-transport.ts:905-915 is removed, and it doesn't depend on a real-clock limit to tell the retry from the 3 s mount timer
